question: At the optimal desorption conditions, what regeneration efficiency was reached, and after five absorption-desorption cycles what remained?
expect: 94.7% at 393.15 K and 80 min; 88.6% of the initial value after five cycles (sec. 3.2)
rendered: At the optimal desorption conditions (desorption temperature of 393.15 K and a duration of 80 min), the regeneration efficiency reached 94.7%. After five absorption-desorption cycles, the regeneration efficiency remained at 88.6% of its initial value, indicating that the absorbent maintains good stability after repeated regeneration.
